biggest_catch: You must apply and be approved for each individual study — the '$200' figure is possible, not typical: the official average study pays just over $45, and qualification/screening is the biggest risk.
catches: Official: 'The average study pays over $45' — the route's $200 is at the high end (possible for in-person or longer online studies), not the norm.
You must apply to each study and be approved; applying does not guarantee selection.
Pay ranges vary by study type: in-person $40–$1,000+, online $20–$1,500+, focus groups $40–$200+, 1:1 interviews $20–$300+, diary studies $55–$400+, surveys/product testing $20–$300+.
Payment arrives a few days after study completion — not same-day.

steps: Create a free account at https://www.userinterviews.com/ and complete your profile.
Browse available studies and apply to ones that fit your demographics.
Complete each study's screener; you must be approved before participating.
Complete the study (online, phone, or in-person).
Get paid within a few days of completion — the exact amount is shown on each study listing before you apply.
timing: Paid within a few days of study completion.
